description: Synthetic, simulator-native covariate-support shifts for held-out HTST profile evaluation. These domains are not measurements of a real plant and must not be presented as evidence of field generalization.

generation_policy.profile_count_semantics: --profiles is the number of ID profiles; --ood-profiles adds held-out profiles
generation_policy.sampling: independent uniform draws over each domain's complete expanded parameter ranges
generation_policy.support_separation: each OOD domain and every other domain must have at least one closed parameter interval separated by a strict gap
generation_policy.split_policy: all non-ID profiles are evaluation-only test_ood_profile
generation_policy.claim_boundary: synthetic support-shift stress test only; not real-world or plant OOD validation
